title: Plungers, mutes and Tricky Sam
summary: They compare plunger and solo-tone mutes, Duke Ellington's effects, Jack Teagarden as open-horn man and Tricky Sam Nanton.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition
